title: Wellness
dek: Recovery, sleep, home-gym and blender gear that tested well this year, to go with the supplement and apparel stores below.

boards.title: Recover and sleep
boards.dek: Massage tools and a sunrise alarm for the hours off.

boards.title: Home-gym dumbbells
boards.dek: Adjustable pairs that replace a rack of weights.

boards.title: Smoothies and shakes
boards.dek: Blenders from Food Network's 2026 testing, from a full-size Vitamix to a portable.

items.name: Theragun Prime Plus
items.why: A percussion massager that adds heat for warming up a muscle before or after a workout. Forbes named it the best wellness gift in its October 2026 men's guide.

items.name: Release and Recover Ball Set
items.why: A small set of massage balls for working knots out of feet, glutes and shoulders, at a fraction of a massage gun's price. NBC Select put it on its list of gifts under $50.
items.ebay: lululemon release and recover ball set

items.name: Shiatsu Neck and Back Massager with Heat
items.why: A heated shiatsu massager that drapes over the neck and shoulders for desk-day tightness. It is on Forbes' 2026 men's gift guide.

items.name: Restore 3 Sunrise Alarm Clock, Putty
items.why: A sunrise alarm, sound machine and reading light in one, which Tom's Guide's sleep testers rank best overall in their October 2026 update. Their caveat: it needs Wi-Fi and the app, and some features sit behind a subscription.

items.name: Results Series 552 SelectTech Adjustable Dumbbells
items.why: A dial-adjust pair that goes from 5 to 52.5 lb and stores in a small footprint; Fitness Volt's 2026 roundup ranks it best overall. It is not made to be dropped, and 52.5 lb is the ceiling.

items.name: Elite EXP Adjustable Dumbbells
items.why: Very compact block-style dumbbells that start at 5 to 50 lb and can be expanded later with add-on kits, which are sold separately. Fitness Volt picks it as the best expandable set.

items.name: Adjustable Dumbbell Set, 5 to 50 lb
items.why: Twist the handle to change weight with one hand, which makes it quick between sets. Fitness Volt names it the best twist-handle set and warns that it needs to sit squarely in its cradle.

items.name: Select-A-Weight 55 lb Adjustable Dumbbells
items.why: The budget pick in Fitness Volt's 2026 roundup, with a 55 lb top weight. It starts at 10 lb and its tray takes more floor space than the others.

items.name: Certified Reconditioned Explorian Series
items.why: The Explorian E310 is Food Network's best-overall blender of 2026, smooth on smoothies and nut butter. Vitamix's own reconditioned version, with the 64-oz container, costs $70 less than new and keeps a 3-year warranty.

items.name: Professional Countertop Blender (BL610)
items.why: Food Network's best-value and best-for-smoothies blender: powerful, with a removable blade and a dishwasher-safe pitcher. Testers note that it is loud.

items.name: Beast Blender, Cloud White
items.why: A 1,000-watt personal blender that handled smoothies, ice and nut butter in Food Network's testing, with a wide jar that is easy to fill. The jar is hand-wash only and won't fit most cup holders.

items.name: BlendJet 2 Portable Blender
items.why: A rechargeable blender that made a protein shake in about 30 seconds in Food Network's test, at about 15 blends per charge. It holds one serving, and you have to take off the lid to drink.
